componentPlan.focusQuote: Sort by comparing each adjacent pair of items in a list in turn, swapping the items if necessary
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Bubble sort is a named algorithm, so tracing adjacent swaps teaches the core pass logic.

componentPlan.focusQuote: Complexity is O(n^2) for arbitrary data, but approaches Θ(n) if the list is nearly in order at the beginning.
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Complexity and naming facts are checkable, so quiz cards reinforce vocabulary and performance behavior.

overview.headline: Bubble sort compares neighbours until the list is ordered

keyPoints.point: Students learn that bubble sort orders a list by comparing each adjacent pair and swapping items when necessary.
keyPoints.quote: Sort by comparing each adjacent pair of items in a list in turn, swapping the items if necessary

keyPoints.point: Students learn that repeating a pass through the list stops only when no swaps are done.
keyPoints.quote: repeating the pass through the list until no swaps are done

keyPoints.point: Students learn that arbitrary data is costly to sort, but a list that is nearly in order needs much less work.
keyPoints.quote: Complexity is O(n^2) for arbitrary data, but approaches Θ(n) if the list is nearly in order at the beginning.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that at least one item reaches its final place each pass, so the last position checked can shrink.
keyPoints.quote: Since at least one item is moved into its final place for each pass, an improvement is to decrement the last position checked on each pass.

keyTerms.gloss: A comparison sort that repeatedly swaps neighbouring out of order items
Alternate name for bubble sort where items sink to their proper position
Alternate name for bubble sort where neighbouring items are exchanged in order
A sort that reorders items within the same list without extra storage
keyTerms.quote: Generalization (I am a kind of ...) in-place sort, stable sort.

keyTerms.gloss: A sort that keeps equal items in their original relative order
keyTerms.quote: Generalization (I am a kind of ...) in-place sort, stable sort.

analysis.pageCoverage: Page defines bubble sort as repeated adjacent comparisons and swaps, notes complexity behavior and improvements, and lists related sorts.
